comments.author: Pedro Ferreira
comments.text:
Description:
With this configuration file:

[mysqld]
server_id=1
skip-log-bin
innodb_buffer_pool_size=4G
performance_schema=off
explicit_defaults_for_timestamp=OFF
character_set_server=utf8mb4
sql_mode='ONLY_FULL_GROUP_BY,STRICT_TRANS_TABLES,NO_ZERO_IN_DATE,NO_ZERO_DATE,ERROR_FOR_DIVISION_BY_ZERO,NO_ENGINE_SUBSTITUTION'
completion_type=NO_CHAIN
event_scheduler=ON
explicit_defaults_for_timestamp=OFF
transaction_isolation=REPEATABLE-READ
autocommit=ON
innodb_strict_mode=OFF
secure_file_priv=
innodb_adaptive_hash_index=OFF
max_prepared_stmt_count=1048576
slow_query_log = ON
long_query_time = 5

Create the server directory and start it, then run these queries:

CREATE TABLE t0 (c0 INT);
INSERT INTO t0 (c0) (VALUES ROW(2));
SET @@SESSION.OPTIMIZER_SWITCH = 'hypergraph_optimizer=on';
INSERT INTO t0 (c0) ((VALUES ROW(1),ROW(row_count())) EXCEPT (VALUES ROW(row_count()),ROW(3)));

The SELECT query will trigger a SEGV sql/item.cc:10508:
res = m_value_ref->save_in_field(to, no_conversions);

The compilation parameters are the same as issue 108148:

-DWITH_DEBUG=1 -DWITH_ASAN=ON -DWITH_UBSAN=ON and boost library version 1.77

How to repeat:
Run the queries above.
